applicationChange: Only remove #svg-stage-wrap will-change: transform; update CSS cache hash. PR 8535437. No JS/animation/onboarding changes in this follow-up.

calloutWidth.observation: Original strict callout check failed twice with opposite signed 0.03125 CSS-pixel width differences. Main produced 275.25 and 275.28125 across those invocations; eight additional same-main contexts all produced 275.25. The variability mechanism was not isolated.
calloutWidth.comparison: Content, caret, positions and height remain exact; width/right tolerate 0.05 CSS px. Failed logs and screenshots retained.

webkitPausedAnimation.observation: The harness deliberately paused the timeline transition at 110 ms. WebKit retained that artificial override after stop; native diagnostic showed it still paused after roughly two seconds.
webkitPausedAnimation.correction: Cancel only test-paused scrubber transitions after measuring glide, before rail/resize checks. Duration and easing checks stay unchanged.

webkitGeometry.observation: Percentage transform reference-width rounding caused a measured 0.46863 CSS-pixel thumb difference.
webkitGeometry.comparison: Use the same 0.51 CSS-pixel budget as existing responsive checks, record absolute errors; do not change application rendering.

webkitInput.limitation: Playwright cannot send mouse-wheel input to mobile WebKit.
webkitInput.coverage: Use the existing trusted + keyboard shortcut for zoom in those contexts; desktop WebKit and Chromium still use trusted wheel input. This does not establish physical iPhone pinch or Safari FPS.
